full_judgment:
Mr. Abdul Jalil, J:-This appeal at the instance of the plaintiff is directed against a judgment and decree dated 22.7.76 passed in Title Suit No. 103 of 1975 by the Subordinate Judge, Patuakhali dismissing the suit for declaration of title on contest with cost. 

 The judgment and decree of the Court below are affirmed.
